card.name: Carbon dioxide and numbers starting a value
card.fires_on: The word Carbon at the start of a sentence or phrase about carbon dioxide or monoxide. Also the digit or space just before a dose or range number.

modes.label: Carbon gas names
modes.description: The word Carbon opening carbon dioxide or carbon monoxide in respiratory text.

modes.label: Start of a number
